title: Quality Life Services - Sarver received CMS rating of 2 for Q1 as for-profit nursing home
text:
As of the first quarter of 2026, Quality Life Services – Sarver was operated by Tack Family Ventures, LLC, according to Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) . Located in Butler County, this nursing home has been under the ownership of Tack Family Ventures, LLC since Nov. 1, 2024.
Quality Life Services – Sarver operates as a for-profit nursing home facility.
That quarter, the facility earned an overall CMS rating of 2, which falls below Pennsylvania’s state nursing home mean of 3.0. CMS assigns these ratings using criteria including health inspection findings, staff numbers, and resident care quality.
Data shows the nursing home provided daily care for an average of 60.6 residents during Q1 2026, with 66 available beds. The facility is not affiliated with a hospital.
Quality Life Services – Sarver had no incidents reported for fines or penalties in the first quarter of 2026.
In total, six for-profit nursing home facilities operated in Butler County, Pennsylvania.
U.S. Census Bureau estimates show the nation’s older adult population is increasing while the number of children is declining. The number of Americans aged 65 and older rose by 13% between 2020 and 2024, while those under 18 decreased by 1.7%. The country’s older population has expanded significantly over the last century, from 4.9 million in 1920 to more than 61 million in 2024.
A 2021 study found that nearly half of Americans in this age range, or about 28 million people, are likely to need long-term services and support, with over a third potentially requiring nursing home care.
“Living a long life is something that many of us want and could get,” said Jesse Slome , executive director of the American Association for Long-Term Care Insurance. “But when we live a long life, the chances of us needing long-term care increase exponentially. But when you need that type of care, there are limited options.”
